items.lede: A new bipartisan effort in Congress to rein in automated license plate readers takes a page from the national drinking age: Comply, or risk losing federal highway funding.
items.title: Lawmakers Want States to Crack Down on Flock Cameras—or Pay the Price

items.lede: A bipartisan bill would restrict Flock cameras to a handful of public safety uses.
items.title: Lawmakers target Flock cameras with a threat to highway funding
